instruction: Candid documentary photograph, low-angle medium full shot. Inside a judo dojo on yellow tatami mats, the woman in the blue judo gi (R1) on the left executes a dramatic throw on the young man in the white judo gi (R2). The woman stands firmly, leaning forward and holding the young man's arm to control his descent. The young man is captured mid-fall, landing on his back with his legs kicked high into the air. Soft indoor lighting illuminates the action, highlighting the texture of the mats.

R1 holds R2's arm to control R2's descent
R2 is mid-fall onto his back with legs kicked high while R1 remains standing
R1 leans forward and stands firmly during the throw
